description: Vivo X500 Pro Max is expected to be in the works. However, the launch does not seem far away, as it has received the 3C certification. It was spotted on the 3C website with model number V2602DA. The listing suggests 90W fast charging support. The listing also suggests 5G connectivity. It is rumoured to run on a MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Reportedly Bags 3C Certification, Charging Speed Revealed

description: A new report claims that Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S26 FE, Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy A07s have surfaced on Google's Play Console Supported Devices list. The listings reportedly include regional versions of all three devices, while the Galaxy Tab S12+ is said to have both Wi-Fi and 5G variants. Certification records in India, South Korea and the US have also reportedly revealed some tablet models. Samsung has not confirmed the devices or announced their launch dates, so their release timelines remain uncertain.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, Galaxy Tab S12+ and Galaxy A07s Spotted on Google Play Console

description: CD Projekt Red has confirmed layoffs at Project Sirius, the multiplayer spinoff title set in The Witcher universe. Nine employees have been impacted by the cuts, while nine others have been invited to take part in internal recruitment processes for potential roles on other CD Projekt Red projects.
title: CD Projekt Red Confirms Layoffs at Project Sirius Witcher Multiplayer Spinoff

description: Samsung is offering revised discounts on the Galaxy S26 lineup during its Freedom Sale, with the Galaxy S26 Ultra reportedly available for Rs. 1,24,999 and the Galaxy S26+ for Rs. 89,500. The standard Galaxy S26 is available at Rs. 79,999 after an Rs. 8,000 discount. The offers also include No Cost EMI plans, along with additional website and referral discounts. Samsung has officially confirmed the Rs. 79,999 starting price, while the higher discounts for the other models were shared by a tipster.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Gets Up to Rs. 30,500 Discount in Freedom Sale: Here's What You Need to Know

description: WhatsApp is reportedly testing new chat themes with animated wallpapers on iOS. It is said to be available in the WhatsApp beta for iOS 26.31.10.74 update, which is available on the TestFlight programme. It could include Featured, Doodle, and Minimal categories for chat themes. The Featured themes category is said to include animated wallpapers.
title: WhatsApp May Soon Let iOS Users Add Animated Wallpapers to Chat Themes

description: PS Plus Game Catalogue titles for August have been revealed. This month, Game Catalogue is adding Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2, Helldivers 2, Vampire Survivors, Hell is Us, and more. Helldivers 2 is now available on Game Catalogue to PS Plus Extra and Deluxe/Premium members.
title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2, Helldivers 2, Hell Is Us and More Join PS Plus Game Catalogue in August

description: Krafton India has once again released a fresh set of redeem codes for Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI). These arrive just a day after the game developer offered players a chance to claim the Mecha Ant Backpack and other in-game rewards. Krafton says using the latest codes, players can unlock the exclusive Smiling Pal Backpack in the game, along with other free rewards. The new code drop comes amid BGMI's ongoing 5th Anniversary celebrations and the recently released 4.5 Update.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes for August 13 Released: How to Claim Smiling Pal Backpack, Other Free Rewards

description: The Vivo Y-series is among the most expansive in the company’s lineup, with similar smartphones available under different monikers across markets. According to a report, an unannounced Vivo handset has recently surfaced on a certification platform, which suggests that its launch could be on the horizon. The listing reportedly reveals the purported smartphone’s model number and moniker. Vivo, however, has yet to officially announce the handset or reveal its specifications.
title: Vivo Y6k Reportedly Spotted on Google Play Console; Could Arrive as Another Rebranded Y-Series Model

description: Apple will reportedly pay LG and Samsung a significantly lower price for their OLED panels, which will be found on the iPhone 18 Pro Max. The price is said to be significantly lower than what the company is paying for the iPhone 17 Pro Max’s OLED panel. The report highlights that the company was paying between $110 (about Rs. 10,500) and $120 (roughly Rs. 11,500) to the same suppliers for each OLED screen for the current generation iPhone 17 Pro Max. Moreover, new details about the iPhone 18 have surfaced online.
title: Apple Reportedly Secures Better Deal for iPhone 18 Pro Series’ OLED Panels; iPhone 18 Leak Hints at New Upgrades

description: Honor Magic 9 series will launch in China in September. The upcoming series is confirmed to feature Honor's Yoyo AI assistant. Meanwhile, tipster Digital Chat Station (translated from Chinese) on Weibo said that the new handsets will be released on September 28. The lineup is tipped to feature a 200-megapixel main camera. The lineup is currently available for pre-order in China.
title: Honor Magic 9 Series Launch Confirmed; Launch Date, Camera Details Tipped Online

description: iQOO Neo 11 Ultra will be powered by an octa-core custom MediaTek Dimensity 9500M chipset, the smartphone maker announced on Thursday. iQOO says that it co-developed the new SoC with MediaTek for the new iQOO Neo 11 series smartphone. The iQOO Neo 11 Ultra will also feature the next-generation “Monster Super Core Engine” (translated from Chinese), which has been integrated directly into the MediaTek chip. Further, the company claims that the custom-built MediaTek Dimensity 9500M chipset will deliver enhanced performance, while also offering improved energy efficiency.
title: iQOO Neo 11 Ultra Confirmed to Launch With a Custom MediaTek Chipset With New 'Monster' Super Core Engine

description: Japanese Bitcoin treasury firm Metaplanet has denied selling 5,014 Bitcoin worth around $320 million (roughly Rs. 3,053 crore) after the transfer was spotted by blockchain monitoring platforms. CEO Simon Gerovich said the coins were moved between the company’s own custodial addresses as part of a routine operation. Metaplanet continues to hold 43,000 BTC, even as the company’s Bitcoin strategy faces pressure from falling prices and losses on its holdings.
title: Metaplanet Denies BTC Liquidation as Bitcoin Falls Below Company's Average Cost

description: A leaked image of the Xiaomi Mix Fold 5 suggests the upcoming foldable could adopt a wider inner display with a 4:3 aspect ratio. The handset is expected to run Xiaomi’s new Android 17-based HyperOS 4, which brings a redesigned interface and new AI capabilities. Another tipster has reportedly backed an early September launch window for the foldable, ahead of the Xiaomi 18 series. Xiaomi has not confirmed the Mix Fold 5 or revealed plans for an international launch.
title: Xiaomi’s Next Foldable Leaked With Wider Screen Ahead of Expected September Launch

description: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold was launched in India on Wednesday as the company's latest book-style foldable. It succeeds last year's Pixel 10 Pro Fold, arriving with a higher price tag, while offering higher base storage. The Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold is equipped with an 8-inch (2,076 x 2,152 pixels) OLED Super Actua Flex display on the inside. Google has equipped the new Pixel 11 Pro Fold with its latest Tensor G6 chipset, along with a Titan M3 security coprocessor. It is backed by a 4,806mAh battery.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold vs Pixel 10 Pro Fold: What's The Difference in Price, Specifications, Features, and More

description: Arizona’s crypto ATM consumer protection law has helped 35 scam victims recover a combined $171,332 (roughly Rs. 1.6 crore) since taking effect in September 2025. Attorney General Kris Mayes urged victims to report fraudulent transactions within the law’s 30-day window to qualify for refunds. The law also places daily transaction limits on crypto ATM users, while the state’s recovery figures arrive amid rising fraud involving cryptocurrency kiosks across the US.
title: Arizona Crypto ATM Law Helps 35 Scam Victims Recover $171,000 in Lost Funds

description: Online sales have become one of the more reliable windows for picking up wireless headphones at a genuine discount, and this year's Independence Day special sales offerings bring a wide enough range that there's something for nearly every budget and use case. Whether you want proper noise cancellation for daily commutes, a more basic passive setup that still delivers on battery life, or something in between with adaptive ANC and transparency mode, brands like boAt, JBL, and Soundcore Anker have headphones on sale that cover most of what a typical buyer is looking for.
title: Top Noise Cancelling Headphones to Buy During Independence Day 2026 Sales: boAt Rockerz 650 Pro, JBL Tune 760, and More

description: Vivo S50t Vitality Edition has been launched in China as the latest addition to the company’s S50 lineup. The handset sports a 6.59-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It is powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 chipset, coupled with up to 16GB of RAM and up to 512GB of onboard storage. Optics are headlined by a 50-megapixel periscope telephoto camera. The Vivo S50t Vitality Edition packs a 6,500mAh battery.
title: Vivo S50t Vitality Edition Launched With Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 SoC, 50-Megapixel Periscope Camera

description: Bitcoin remained near Rs. 61 lakh after July US CPI data came broadly in line with expectations. The cryptocurrency continues to face resistance around Rs. 62 lakh, while traders await the US PPI report for further clues on the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $64,000 as In-Line US CPI Offers Little Direction

description: The Realme 16x 5G is now available for purchase in India, a day after it was launched. The handset is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, coupled with up to 6GB of RAM and up to 256GB of onboard storage. It sports a 6.8-inch display with a 144Hz refresh rate. For optics, it gets a 50-megapixel rear camera and an 8-megapixel selfie shooter. The Realme 16x 5G packs a 7,000mAh battery with 45W fast charging support.
title: Realme 16x 5G Goes on Sale in India With 144Hz Display, 7,000mAh Battery: Price, Offers

description: Pova 8 Pro 5G will be launched in India on August 18, the company announced on Thursday. The tech firm has also revealed that the upcoming smartphone will be equipped with a secondary display on the back, Alive Matrix Display, namely placed next to the camera module. The Pova 8 Pro 5G is teased to feature a new button finished in orange on the right side. The phone will also boast a flat metal frame. More details, including the key specifications and features, are expected to be revealed closer to the handset’s launch.
title: Pova 8 Pro 5G India Launch Date Revealed Along With Design; Will Feature a Secondary Display on the Rear

description: New OTT releases this week include Cocktail 2, Reacher Season 4, Aakhri Sawaal, Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata, Kattalan and more across Netflix, Prime Video, JioHotstar, ZEE5 and other platforms.
title: OTT Releases This Week (Aug 10 - Aug 16): Cocktail 2, Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata, Reacher Season 4, Aakhri Sawaal, and More

description: Wireless earbuds stopped being a simple music accessory a while ago. These days they're expected to double as a noise-cancelling shield on your commute, a calling device for back-to-back meetings, and occasionally a low-latency companion for gaming, all from the same tiny case. The boAt Nirvana Zenith Pro is pitched as exactly that kind of all-rounder. It brings Hi-Res Audio, Spatial Audio, Hybrid Adaptive ANC, AI-assisted calling, and a battery built to go the distance, all at a price most people would find highly attractive.
title: 6 Everyday Scenarios Where the boAt Nirvana Zenith Pro Can Elevate Your Audio Experience

description: Google’s latest Gemini update broadens its reach beyond Google’s own ecosystem by linking the AI assistant with services used for bookings, music, home services and healthcare. The rollout comes as Gemini crosses 1 billion monthly users, with Google reporting growing use of voice, Gemini Live and image generation. The company is also preparing to phase out Google Assistant on Android, with Gemini set to take over as the default assistant on eligible devices from September.
title: Google Gemini Expands Connected Apps With OpenTable, Ticketmaster and More

description: CloudSEK said that over 2,500 companies and 4,34,000 CI/CD pipelines across the world were exposed in the supply chain breach. The attack occurred in March 2026, and the threat actor group TeamPCP orchestrated a supply chain attack targeting AI infrastructure by compromising LiteLLM. The attack reportedly exposed data of companies including MediaTek, Microsoft, X, Amazon, Cisco, Samsung and Salesforce.
title: CloudSEK Identifies AI Supply Chain Exposure Affecting More Than 2,500 Organisations

description: Ghost of Yotei is getting a new story expansion and a new roguelike single-player mode. Developer Sucker Punch has announced that the story DLC, titled Echoes of Sekigahara, and other new content, will be released on October 1. Ghost of Yotei will also be available in a Complete Edition, that includes the base game and the upcoming DLC.
title: Ghost of Yotei Will Get Its First Story Expansion and a New Roguelike Single-Player Mode in October

description: Google has finally taken the wraps off its Pixel 11 series almost exactly a year after the Pixel 10. The new handsets come with a familiar design, but pack some notable upgrades under the hood. Even the base Pixel 11, which is the most affordable model in Google’s lineup, gets the new Tensor G6 chipset, along with faster wireless charging, a larger battery, and the latest Android 17 OS. Some features, meanwhile, have been carried over from its predecessor, with the 6.3-inch 120Hz display being one of them.
title: Google Pixel 11 vs Pixel 10: What's The Difference in Price, Specifications, Features, and More

description: Boat launched the new Aavante Bar Prime soundbar series in India. The series includes Aavante Bar Prime DA600, Aavante Bar Prime B450 and Aavante Bar Prime Thunder-D. The lineup offers up to 600W of sound, 5.2-channel surround sound, Dolby technologies and dual subwoofers. The lineup offers Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity. They offer HDMI (eARC), USB, AUX and Optical connectivity.
title: Boat Aavante Bar Prime Soundbar Series Launched in India With Up to 600W Sound: Price, Specifications

description: The Pixel 11 Pro XL starts at Rs. 1,34,999 in India, making it Rs. 10,000 more expensive than the Pixel 10 Pro XL. For the higher price, the newer model gets Google’s Tensor G6 chipset, a brighter 6.8-inch display, faster wired charging, the new HiLight system and up to 120x Pro Zoom. The Pixel 10 Pro XL counters with 16GB RAM and a larger 5,200mAh battery. Both phones share similar cameras, 25W wireless charging and IP68 protection, but differ in performance, battery life and features.
title: Pixel 11 Pro XL vs Pixel 10 Pro XL: What's The Difference in Price, Specifications, Features, and More
Why realme 16x 5G Might Be the Best/Perfect All-Rounder Phone You've Been Waiting For

description: Google is rolling out a new feature update for the Pixel Buds Pro 2 from September, bringing improvements to noise cancellation, Gemini controls, sleep detection and Live Translate. Dynamic ANC will adapt to changes in the earbuds’ fit, while Pixel Watch integration can pause playback and disable touch controls after the wearer falls asleep. Live Translate now supports two-way conversations across more than 70 languages. Google has also added an Olive colour option, while the earbuds retain their Tensor A1 chip and existing hardware specifications.
title: Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 Get New Olive Finish, Dynamic ANC, Gemini Controls and More

description: Pixel 11 Pro has recently launched in India and other global markets with the Tensor G6 processor and a Titan M3 security chip. It comes with a 6.3-inch display, 16GB of RAM and Android 17. Let's compare the Google Pixel 11 Pro against its predecessor, the Google Pixel 10 Pro, to figure out the differences between the phones.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro vs Google Pixel 10 Pro: What's the Difference in Price, Specifications, Features, and More

description: Google launched its next-generation smartphones and smartwatch during the Made by Google event on Wednesday. The event also saw the launch of the Google Pixel Tag, the tech giant's first Bluetooth tracker. On top of this, the company also launched the Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 in a new Olive colour option. The TWS are also set to receive an update, which is claimed to improve active noise cancellation. All four smartphones in the Pixel 11 lineup feature the Google Tensor G6 chipset, paired with the latest Titan M3 security coprocessor.
title: Made by Google Event Roundup: Google Pixel 11 Series, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag and Everything Else Announced

description: Google Fitbit Air will be launched in India this year, the Mountain View-based tech giant announced on Thursday. The Fitbit Air was recently unveiled in select global markets as the tech giant’s first fitness tracker with a screen-free design.
title: Google Fitbit Air Confirmed to Launch in India in October: Specifications, Features

description: The Google Pixel 11 series was launched in India and the global markets on Tuesday, but in an unusual way. The Mountain View-based tech giant had announced its Made by Google event weeks in advance, but the handsets, along with other devices, were unveiled hours before the event even officially got underway. The new lineup includes four models — the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold — giving buyers a range of options across different price points. As is often the case, what you pay for the same Pixel model can vary substantially depending on where you buy it.
title: Pixel 11 Price Comparison: US vs UK vs India vs Europe — Where Is It Cheapest to Buy?
